llvm_mca.qualification: LLVM-MCA 16 has neither Lion Cove nor Skymont. Its Tremont model cannot parse AVX2 variable shifts, so Alder Lake is only a directional Intel P-core proxy and Zen 2 is retained solely as a cross-architecture sensitivity check. Neither scheduling-model estimate replaces measurement on each Core Ultra 7 255H core type.
